scope: Bazarr, Prowlarr, Radarr, Sonarr and SABnzbd vendor images, linux/amd64 only.
method: Scoped read-only live metadata and public CA-file reads; immutable registry manifests/configs; daemonless public PEM exports. Historical image evidence was reused only on exact repository plus resolved amd64 child-manifest match.
coverage: Public PEM inspection and Python SSLContext root enumeration are not embedded-runtime or end-to-end chain rejection certification. .NET cached or user-added trust stores were not enumerated. No images were executed for the registry audit.

bazarr.blocker: Newest observed stable v1.6.2-ls369 remains denied in both OS and vendored application certifi stores. Development 1.6.3-beta builds were not substituted for stable.
bazarr.coverage: Actual public PEM reads and Python native/context root enumeration; no application chain rejection or broader embedded-runtime certification.

prowlarr.blocker: Newest observed stable 2.6.5.5623-ls165 retains denied OS roots. Development/nightly channels are not verified compatible replacements.
prowlarr.coverage: Actual public PEM reads and public .NET runtimeconfig metadata only; native/embedded runtime trust is not certified.

radarr.compatibility: Same Radarr application version 6.4.4.10685, vendor build ls323 -> ls324. Explicit audited amd64 child digest; no chart, runtime override, storage, replica or application configuration changes.
radarr.coverage: Fresh registry export selected vendor PEM files clear; candidate image was not executed and native/embedded runtime trust is not certified. Existing live image remains denied until separately approved deployment.

rejected_older_candidate.reason: Vendor build numbering reset; numeric ls329 is older than the currently deployed ls1. Current stable alias resolves to the deployed clear child.

sonarr.coverage: Fresh immutable registry PEM scan and actual live public PEM reads clear; native/embedded runtime trust and end-to-end chain rejection are not certified.

sabnzbd.blocker: Newest observed stable 5.1.3-ls278 has clear OS roots but application certifi still contains the denied root. Unstable 5.2 beta/nightly builds are not verified compatible replacements.

live_runtime.additional_mutable_surface: Existing pinned universal-package-install mod installs ffmpeg on startup from Alpine repositories. No mod, package or startup behavior changed.

sabnzbd.coverage: Actual public PEM reads and Python native/context root enumeration; no application chain rejection or broader embedded-runtime certification.

rollout_gates: NO cluster writes, reconcile, restart or deployment were performed.
Coordinator reports existing Longhorn manager readiness failure on both workers. Storage recovery is mandatory before any deployment; fleet-coordinator-safety-baseline.json is failed, not clearance.

Coordinator alone serializes live deployment. Preserve Radarr Recreate and existing PVC mounts; verify old process exit, PVC attachment/mounts, readiness and application health before considering it deployed.
After approved Radarr deployment, verify exact live amd64 imageID, public trust stores and native/application chain rejection. PEM-clear is not runtime certification.

Bazarr, Prowlarr and SABnzbd require compatible vendor-patched stable builds. No Plex paths, startup sanitizer, trust override, TLS verification disable, runtime package update or unsafe fallback was added.
No Sonarr rollout is needed for this change; preserve its already PEM-clear immutable ls1 build.
